title: Graham Hancock's first article on the Ark of the Covenant

tellings.quote: interviewed Graham Hancock and his the first piece that he ever did was it was like for a I think a magazine or something and he was writing an article on the ark of the covenant.

plain: The writer Graham Hancock's very first piece of writing was an article about the Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest described in the Bible. Michels says this is what Hancock told him when he interviewed him, and that he thinks the article was for a magazine. He brings it up as a sign of how early Hancock's interest in lost ancient mysteries began.
